meta.title: Surrogate bid: a counter offer is not allowed on it

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on its Responses screen as required for this state.
Open the stage's Participants tab so a surrogate bid can be added.
Add a buyer-entered bid for the first eligible invited vendor.
Verify that the surrogate bid was accepted.
Return to Responses to test the counter-offer control for the surrogate bid.

args.because: You cannot send counter offer for bids added by you.

steps.note: Attempt the Counter Offer action and require Procol's refusal for a buyer-added bid.
